svg.title: AI Automation for Graphic Design
svg.desc: Seven-stage fan-out workflow for graphic design automation: a brief lands via form submit and Zapier, brand kit assets load from Google Drive, Adobe Firefly and Midjourney generate concepts via API call, a Make scenario builds the layout in Canva or Figma, five size variants fan out via auto-resize, a designer picks the winner, and the export pack lands in a Google Drive folder.
